# Eddy Hage-Youssef

> Personal website of Eddy Hage-Youssef, a final-year undergraduate in Computer Science and Statistics at McGill University. His research is at the intersection of generative AI and economic decision-making.

Eddy works with Professor Maxime Cohen on applied AI research, including industry collaborations to build and deploy practical AI agents. He is interested in how large language models behave when deployed in high-stakes commercial settings (such as setting prices and wages) and what biases emerge. His work combines empirical methods from statistics with AI system building. His work has been featured in Harvard Business Review. He also works with the European Competition team at Charles River Associates as a contracted consultant, designing and deploying internal AI tools for legal case work.

Contact: eddy.hage1@gmail.com
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=p1FFzvkAAAAJ&hl=en
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0004-3183-8364

## Selected publications

- [When AI Sets Wages: Biases and Labor Discrimination in Generative Pricing](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s43681-026-01472-x): AI & Ethics, 2026 (with Maxime C. Cohen and Warut Khern-am-nuai).
- [What Happens When AI Sets Wages](https://hbr.org/2025/10/what-happens-when-ai-sets-wages): Harvard Business Review, 104(2):40-42, 2026.
- [Three Winning AI Strategies](https://cmr.berkeley.edu/2026/08/69-1-three-winning-ai-strategies/): California Management Review, 2026.
- [Confirmation Bias in LLM Pricing Recommendations](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7111078): Manufacturing & Service Operations Management, major revision.
- [Generative AI and Competition for Web Data](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7577638): forthcoming in CPI TechREG Chronicle.
- [Generative AI for Data Scraping](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5353923): INFORMS Journal on Data Science, minor revision.

- Research areas: large language models in pricing and wage-setting, bias and fairness in generative AI, generative AI and web data, and AI competition strategy.
